_doc: A/B for the WAL-machinery optimization --wal-batched-markwritten. Baseline takes the inner shard lock twice per append (reserve + mark_written); batched pushes the completed lsn to a side buffer and lets the committer fold the batch into the watermark in one inner acquisition, cutting appender inner traffic 2->1. Hypothesis: less inner-lock contention -> faster commit cycle -> lower durwait -> higher throughput, most visible at high inflight (50k streams, 6 pods x 128 conns). Both arms syncfs on. Capture SRV_STATS (durwait/stage) from the server pod. Local kind: durwait is dominated by slow Docker fsync, so if batched helps HERE it's via reduced contention; confirm the machinery win cleanly on remote NVMe after.
